title: Jagbabii - 5 and 20
htmlContent:
Jagbabii's "5 and 20" is that music you play and all your problems go away. The vibes are endless and does it part to make sure the people get something to make the world, a cooler place to be with a stand out sound packed with soul, and laced with grooves to make you want to keep listening to his sound on full bloom.

his record doesn’t waste a second of your time, with the magic happening as soon you hit play. The grooves in the music are infectious, as it pumps life into the record sets the ultimate tone for the work he delivers. With the tone set Jagbabii shines to the fullest with a masterful tone, that keeps this part going as the lyrics fly with ease on this track to make it the perfect listen for us all to enjoy.
